v.1: When the sky is split open
v.2: and gives ear to its Lord as it should.
v.3: When the earth is spread out
v.4: and throws out what is in it, emptying itself,
v.5: and gives ear to its Lord as it should.
v.6: O man! You are labouring toward your Lord laboriously, and you will encounter Him.
v.7: Then, as for him who is given his record [of deeds] in his right hand,
v.8: he will receive an easy reckoning,
v.9: and he will return to his folks joyfully.
v.10: But as for him who is given his record from behind his back,
v.13: Indeed he used to be joyful among his folk,
v.14: and he thought that he would never return.
v.15: Yes, his Lord had been watching him.
v.16: I swear by the evening glow,
v.17: by the night and what it is fraught with,
v.18: by the moon when it blooms full:
v.19: you will surely fare from stage to stage.
v.20: What is the matter with them that they will not believe,
v.21: and will not prostrate when the Quran is recited to them?
v.23: and Allah knows best what they keep to themselves.
v.24: So inform them of a painful punishment,
v.25: excepting such as are faithful and do righteous deeds: for them there will be an everlasting reward.
